== Summary ==
Original Japanese printing of [[Blizzard 1 (Japanese)]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Extracted unchanged from the original embedded JPEG on encyclopedia p. 43.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

Source PDF SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">07bb3a1fbdd1a65f6cafdff1fca821108ff8210c82da70a10b988ea7539d1665</code>. Embedded image xref: 2057. Original image SHA256: <code style="white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere">dfa152115bc0fec675f6d00a09012bcbe36cd9a85f9a7279af9b4bca357b2869</code>. No resize, crop, retouching or reconstruction.

The card credits Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998. This image documents the historical printing.
